summary: Iteration 31: tested staff referral suggestions (pending, visibility, approve, reject, files, share block), the postcode filter, Home 'Fresh recommendations' and Activity -> event prefill. Backend: 18/18 pytest pass, using a temporary second employee session. Frontend: one CRITICAL blocker fixed. app/directory.tsx:271 had a stray '}' after the 'Make it a team event' block (')}}'), a JSX syntax error (TS1381) that would break the Metro bundle. After the fix, every requested UI flow passed at 390x844. No deprecated Expo packages detected.

minor.issue: No pending-visibility check (visible_q is not applied). Another employee who knows the ids can download files attached to someone else's pending suggestion. Found by code review only, not tested.
The suggester is not told when an admin rejects their suggestion. The entry just disappears. Optional: add a 'not approved' notification for pending entries.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED by testing agent: stray '}' at line 271 ('                )}}') caused a JSX syntax error (TS1381) and would break the bundle.

issues: Header title 'Therapist · Trusted Referral Partner…' runs into the headerRight 'Suggest' button. The add-circle icon overlaps the 'S' at 390px width; admin's shorter 'Add' label fits. Fix: set headerTitle numberOfLines/maxWidth or use a shorter title.
Subtitle says 'Admins can add entries here.' Employees can now suggest referral partners, so it should say 'Tap Suggest to recommend one.'
The 'Fresh recommendations' SectionHeader testID 'home-latest-reviews' isn't rendered because SectionHeader only uses testID on the action Pressable. Testing only, not visible to users.

action_items: Check the directory.tsx:271 fix (stray '}' removed). Run `npx tsc --noEmit` before handoff to catch JSX syntax errors.
Apply the pending-visibility check in GET /directory/{id}/files/{file_id} (admins and the suggester only while pending).
Fix the header title overlapping 'Suggest' on the referral list for employees.
Update the employee empty-state subtitle on the referral list to mention Suggest.
Optional: notify the suggester on reject. Optional: pass testID to the SectionHeader root View.
critical_code_review_comments: directory.tsx:271 JSX syntax error ('}' as JSX text). Fixed.
get_file skips visible_q, so pending-entry files can leak to other employees.
share_entry/rate_entry use find_one without visible_q. This is safe today: share returns 400 for pending entries, and referrals can't be rated.
Admin notification targets admins with the same 'hidden' flag as the suggester. That's intentional test isolation (test users only notify the hidden test admin) and works.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows after the syntax fix

seed_data_creation: Temporary user_TEST_emp2 + session and TEST_ directory entries/notifications were created and then cleaned up. Settings 'referral_share_channel' is unchanged (conv_ab9e05c17d16). No events created. No shares sent.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use `python tests/seed_iter31_ui.py seed|cleanup` for UI data: referral entries with postcodes 6027/6030/6065/6000/none, Activity dir_TEST_act31, Supplier dir_TEST_sup31 with a review. The pytest creates a second employee session (TEST_session_emp2_iter31) for the visibility tests. Run with -n 0. Verified: postcode radius 0->1, ±10->3, ±50->5, all->6 (no-postcode entries sorted last); event prefill passes title/location/description through URL params.
rca_of_issue: Typo in the new Activities 'Make it a team event' block: an extra '}' after the closing ')}', which JSX parses as text and rejects.
